summary: Ferrin Knob fire tower in the Pisgah Ranger District: a hiking guide says only concrete footings remain, and a map site lists a ruin. No build date found.

facts.status_note: A hiking guide says only the concrete footings of the tower remain; a map site lists the site as a ruin.

access.note: Reached on foot by trail from the Beaver Dam Gap Overlook on the Blue Ridge Parkway. The level is inferred from the hiking guide's trail description, not from a Forest Service page.

visit.trail_note: Start at the Beaver Dam Gap Overlook, milepost 401.7; the climb begins at once on the white-blazed Mountains-to-Sea and Shut-In trail. Only footings remain, so there is no tower to climb.

evidence.supports: A fire lookout tower once stood on the summit
evidence.quote: Once, a fire lookout tower rose from its summit

evidence.supports: 4,000-foot peak in the Pisgah Ranger District
evidence.quote: Ferrin Knob is the easternmost 4,000-foot peak in the Pisgah Ranger District

evidence.supports: Beside the Blue Ridge Parkway south of Asheville; trail starts at the Beaver Dam Gap Overlook, MP 401.7
evidence.quote: The loop begins and ends at the Beaver Dam Gap Overlook at MP 401.7 along the Blue Ridge Parkway south of Asheville.

evidence.supports: Only concrete footings remain; summit again covered with forest and brush
evidence.quote: Today, however, all that remains are the concrete footings of the tower while the summit is once again thickly covered in forest and brush.

evidence.supports: The climb begins immediately from the trailhead
evidence.quote: The climb of Ferrin Knob begins immediately.

evidence.supports: The route starts on the white-blazed MST/Shut-In trail
evidence.quote: To begin, set out on the white-blazed MST/Shut-In Trail as it departs east from the parking lot.

evidence.supports: Map site lists a ruin called Ferin Fire Tower at 4,022 feet in Buncombe County
evidence.quote: Ferin Fire Tower is a ruins in Upper Hominy Township , Buncombe , North Carolina and has an elevation of 4,022 feet.

evidence.supports: Map site latitude 35.45955 (longitude -82.67303); about 12 m from the listed tower by our calculation
Lookout-tower list: Ferrin Knob tower in Buncombe County at 35.45944, -82.67305

notes_for_editor: No build date, height, design, staffing or removal date appears in any source read, so the record has no dated events. The dwhike guide is the only source on the footings and the trail; Mapcarta's 'ruins' label comes from map data and says nothing about the site beyond its type. No NHLR or FFLOS page for Ferrin Knob was in the cache. Failed reads: byway.world (HTTP 429, twice), AllTrails (HTTP 403), a Blue Ridge Now article (HTTP 403), and guessed nhlr and weebly URLs (HTTP 404). The byway.world entry may be worth retrying later; it is listed as a historic site with an elevation. The read count went past the six-page budget because of those failures.
